passage.title: Bindi's Snowy Home
passage.text:
Bindi the wombat lives high in the mountains, where the air is cold and the ground is covered in snow every winter. The higher you climb up a mountain, the colder it gets.

Bindi has a thick coat of fur to keep her warm. She digs a long burrow under the ground, and her pouch faces backwards, so no dirt gets in while she digs.

When spring comes, the sun warms the mountain and the snow begins to melt. The melting snow trickles into little streams, and the streams join together to make a big river that flows all the way down the valley.

One morning, a rock slide blocked the path to Bindi's favourite grassy meadow. “I'll need some help to get there,” she said, looking up at the tall peak.

mission.title: The Blocked Pass
mission.goal: Clear the way to Bindi's meadow and find the Compass piece!

intro.line: Brrr! Hello, Sparky! A rock slide has blocked the path up to my grassy meadow.
Wren says there's a piece of the Heartwood Compass hidden near the top, too!
Let's climb Peak Pass together and clear the way, Bindi!
First, read my story on the Story Stone, so you know all about the mountain.

beats.setup: I flew all over the mountain! Listen to what I saw, and I'll show you the way up.
beats.success: Yes! Follow me, it's up this way!
beats.fail: Hmm, that's not what I said. Listen again, Sparky!
beats.clue: Wren spotted the trail up the left side

beats.setup: This old trail sign spun round in the wind. Answer a question about my story to fix it.
beats.success: The sign points up the mountain now. This way!
beats.fail: The sign is still spinning. Let's read my story again.
beats.clue: The sign points to the peak

beats.setup: Rumble... I am Granite. I fell across the path. Tell me what my mountain words mean, and I'll roll aside.
beats.success: Well spoken! I'll roll out of your way.
beats.fail: Rumble... not quite. I'll stay put for now.

beats.setup: The rock slide broke the bridge over the stream. Count the logs with me and we'll fix it!
beats.success: Good counting! The bridge is fixed. Across we go!
beats.fail: Oops, the logs rolled into the stream. Let's count again.

beats.setup: Hoo! I'm Echo. This frozen ladder needs warming up. Use your science brain to melt the ice!
beats.success: Hoo hoo! The ice melted and the ladder is free!
beats.fail: Hoo... the ice is still frozen. Think again.
beats.clue: The ice on the ladder melted

beats.setup: Someone left a chest with a pattern lock. Work out what comes next to open it.
beats.success: Click! There's a clue inside: dig where the snow meets the grass!
beats.fail: Clunk. The lock stayed shut. Look at the pattern again.
beats.clue: Dig where the snow meets the grass

beats.setup: This snowy cave needs a password. Listen carefully and write it to open the door!
beats.success: The cave is open! The meadow is just ahead!
beats.fail: That's not the password. Let's try again.

finale.line: My meadow! And look, X marks the spot. Dig, Sparky, dig!
Another piece of the Heartwood Compass! It's shining!
Hoo! Take it back to Wildlands. The Heartwood will grow even stronger.
